Work with us

Get involved

Every contribution — of money, time or expertise — powers real education, empowerment and relief for vulnerable communities. There are four ways to stand with the Foundation.

OverviewDonatePartner with usVolunteerBecome an ambassador

Four ways to stand with the Foundation

01

Donate

Fund a child's school year, a household's shelter repair, or a trader's start in business. One-off or recurring gifts, from ₦5,000 upward.

Recurring giving matters more to us than any single total, because it lets us commit to a child for a full academic year.

Give now

02

Partner with us

Bring your organisation's resources, reach or technical expertise to a shared programme of work.

Partnership is how we multiply our impact, and we welcome programme partners, funders, technical collaborators and institutional allies.

Start a conversation

03

Volunteer

Give your time and skills in your own community and on our outreaches.

Volunteers working with children are subject to vetting and a code of conduct.

Apply to volunteer

04

Become an ambassador

Champion our mission and amplify its impact beyond borders.

Our ambassadors carry the Foundation's work into their own networks, at home and in the diaspora.

Register your interest

For institutional funders

If you are considering funding us

Each programme on this site has a written model behind it — who it serves, what the standard package contains, what it costs per person, how it is measured and when support ends. We are glad to share the relevant model and to talk openly about what we can and cannot yet evidence.

We would rather begin a funding relationship with an accurate picture than an impressive one.

Talk to us about funding See our accountability section

What a funder can expect from us

  • Programme models with defined costs and indicators
  • Honest reporting, including where results disappoint
  • Restricted funds honoured and separately accounted
  • A safeguarding standard binding on staff, volunteers and partners
  • A named contact who will answer a difficult question directly
